summary: Tenant isolation as the product itself guards it: its tenant-SQL check, which fails on any new query over a tenant table that neither filters by organisation nor says how it is scoped, and its row-level security check (every tenant table under a policy for the tenant role, then a live two-organisation probe), run on an embedded throwaway database. (Its per-tool isolation sweep runs in the functional lane's smoke row, which it ends.)
not_covered: check:rls here runs on an embedded throwaway database (PGlite) built by the product's own migrations: it proves the migrations put row-level security in place, not that the deployed database has it. The deployed database is proven by the deploy itself (provision.py runs the same check against it and records datastores.postgres.rls_verified; a failure is a failed health check).
Queries the product's baseline file lists as pending review (scripts/tenant-sql-baseline.json) are reported by the product's own check, not failed.

checks.name: check:tenant-sql

requires.else: Install the product's own dependencies into the codebase's ignored folders (no lockfile is written there): npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/orchestrator ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/web install --no-package-lock

checks.why: The product's own `npm run check:tenant-sql`: a query over a tenant table with no organisation filter and no scoping note.

checks.name: check:rls
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && env -u CLICKHOUSE_URL DATABASE_URL= PGLITE_DIR="$d" npm run --silent check:rls; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s

requires.else: Install the product's own dependencies into the codebase's ignored folders (no lockfile is written there): npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/orchestrator ci && npm --prefix molds/mold_v0/codebase/web install --no-package-lock

checks.why: The product's own `npm run check:rls` (mold_v0-031) on a fresh embedded database: a tenant table without row-level security or a policy, a tenant role that bypasses it, or one organisation reaching another's rows in the live probe.
